The order is complete. The confirmation page at https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html says "Thank you for your order!" and I've left it open in its tab.

- **Login:** I logged in as `standard_user`.
- **Sort:** I sorted the products by Price (low to high).
- **Cart:** I added Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99).
- **Checkout:** I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The item total was $39.98, tax $3.20, and the order total **$43.18**.

The browser's normal click command reported success but did nothing on this site. I finished the cart, checkout and Finish steps by triggering the buttons through the page's script instead. All of it was done through the browser tool.

**Final answer: order complete, total $43.18.**

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://www.saucedemo.com && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i
B="agent-browser --session task-fc1eed6ed9fa"; $B fill @e5 standard_user && $B fill @e6 secret_sauce && $B click @e4 && $B wait --url "**/inventory.html" && $B snapshot -i
